name: Introduction and overview — Kilo-class Submarine — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Kilo-class Submarine
description: Introduction and overview of the Kilo-class Submarine: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Soviet Kilo class (Project 877/636) — 70+ built — earned the nickname 'Black Hole' in the West for its quietness. Exported to China, India, Iran, Vietnam, and Algeria, the improved Kilo 636 fires Kalibr cruise missiles. It is the most numerous modern diesel-electric submarine class. Baseline facts: Soviet/Russian diesel-electric submarine; 70+ built; 'Black Hole' quietness; Kalibr missiles..
how_it_works: Buoyancy supports the hull; propellers driven by diesel, turbine, or nuclear plant provide thrust; rudders and thrusters steer; stability comes from hull form and ballast.
